# Ixeia Sánchez Périz

> Senior Software Engineer in Data & AI Systems at SWISS International Air Lines, Zürich. Works on AI agents, ML systems and TB-scale PySpark data pipelines. Previously researcher at ETH Zürich on distributed, fault-tolerant LLM training (Sailor, published at SOSP '25). MSc Data Science, ETH Zürich; double BSc Telecommunication Engineering & Business Administration, UPV Valencia (1st in class).

This file is a plain-text guide to the site for LLM agents and tools. The human site is at https://ixsanpe.github.io/ and has the same content with an interactive layout.

## Experience

- Senior Software Engineer, Data & AI Systems — SWISS International Air Lines, Zürich (Jun 2024 – present): AI agents and ML systems adopted across business units; TB-scale data pipelines with PySpark; system design and adoption.
- Researcher, LLM Systems at Scale — ETH Zürich (Oct 2023 – May 2024): designed and built Sailor's elastic, fault-tolerant runtime for LLM training on preemptible VMs (2.87× higher goodput; published at SOSP '25); also worked on its cost-effective resource planner.
- Junior Machine Learning Engineer — Visium, AI consulting start-up, Zürich (Mar 2023 – Aug 2023): data pipelines and automated ML model deployment for clients on GCP.
- Data Scientist Intern — Corify Care, medtech start-up, Valencia (Jun 2020 – Jul 2021): real-time streaming ECG classification in a medical device; cost-effectiveness study published in Value in Health (ISPOR), 2022.

Skills: Python, PySpark, Databricks, BigQuery, GCP, PyTorch, DeepSpeed, Ray, Kubernetes, Docker, LLM agents, RAG, evals, MLOps.

## Projects

- [Sailor: automated ML training in the cloud](https://ixsanpe.github.io/projects/sailor-llm.html): ETH Zürich master's thesis. Ixeia designed and built Sailor's elastic, fault-tolerant runtime for LLM training on spot instances. Checkpoints live in CPU memory and surviving nodes are reconfigured in place, so a 1.5B-parameter model is training again 52 s after a preemption; 2.87× higher goodput than state-of-the-art fault tolerance. Includes a 56 s video of one recovery. Ixeia also worked on Sailor's resource planner, which the page mentions without detail. [Paper (SOSP '25)](https://dl.acm.org/doi/10.1145/3731569.3764839), [code](https://github.com/eth-easl/sailor).
- [Fitness RAG](https://ixsanpe.github.io/projects/fitness-rag.html): end-to-end retrieval system over 873 exercises; hybrid BM25 + dense retrieval with RRF, contrastive fine-tuning (Recall@10 0.36 → 0.81), MLflow, Milvus Lite, local LLM; labelled eval set. [Code](https://github.com/ixsanpe/fitness-ai-assistant).

## Optional

- How the portfolio is organised: the homepage draws the projects as one AI system. Unstructured data feeds the systems (RAG + MLOps; Sailor for LLM training), which run on infrastructure (Ray, GPUs, cloud) and power a solution (Fitness RAG). Underneath is Ixeia: building the systems, giving talks and learning through ongoing projects.
- In progress: unstructured data processing (turning raw text into clean, structured data: parsing, chunking, data quality); Ray Data & distributed GPU training (learning hands-on); a second brain (AI to capture, organise and find notes); a coding harness (agents, tools and workflows for building software with AI).
